media.title: transform — what the model sees and returns

lines.text: units: p0 p1 p2 l1_0 l1_1 l1_2 p3
assertCoverage: every unit referenced exactly once ✓
stats.value "94%" is a substring of p3 ✓
rehydrate body text from source … done

vo.text: Here's how it keeps that promise. The source is split into numbered units, and the model only returns block types and unit ids. It has no channel to write body text at all.
Every unit must be used exactly once, and any number it highlights must appear in the original, or the block falls back to plain prose.

scenes.headline: Parse first. [Then] let the model choose.

vo.text: Structure is parsed before any model runs, and the model costs about fifteen output tokens a block, because it never copies paragraphs.
With no API key, it falls back to a clearly labelled demo mode, so it always works and costs nothing to try.
Read anything, beautifully, word for word.
